15/G.goal: Explain the landscape of augmented reality hardware by category, covering headsets, smart glasses, handheld devices, spatial systems, head-up displays, and contact lenses with their examples, components, operation, and uses.
15/G.achieves: Builds the hardware foundation needed to understand how AR systems present and interact with the real world and to make informed choices about AR devices and constraints in later XR system development.

15/O1.goal: Describe the main categories of augmented reality hardware and distinguish their representative examples, components, operation, and application domains.
15/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a foundational map of AR hardware so they can understand device capabilities and limitations when designing, selecting, or implementing AR systems later in the course.
